task.description:
Design and implement test coverage for IN-UI-05, IN-UI-06, IN-UI-07, IN-UI-08 in Playwright E2E tests against the real backend. Update or extend web/tests/e2e/f3-instance-monitoring.e2e.spec.ts and add/update tests/specs entries as needed.

Requirements:
- IN-UI-05 (MUST): verify history tab filters and expandable raw payload JSON
- IN-UI-06 (MUST): verify timeline tab feed, avatar rendering, human-readable text
- IN-UI-07 (MUST): verify cancel action with confirmation dialog and optimistic status update (and rollback behavior expectation on failure path if testable)
- IN-UI-08 (SHOULD): verify auto-refresh indicator + manual refresh trigger

Testing directives: no mocks/stubs, real backend only, visual assertions after significant UI actions.

REWORK 1:
- [BLOCKER] IN-UI-06 timeline feed test cannot validate avatar/timestamp/human-readable entry rendering because the timeline tab showed no entries for seeded instances.
- Resolve root cause fully (test data setup, page wiring, or API behavior), then rerun Playwright and produce passing validation for IN-UI-06.
- Do not defer; unblock within this step.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement has a runnable Playwright E2E test
Tests use real backend (no HTTP mocking)
Visual/DOM assertions confirm rendered UX behavior
Test spec artifacts updated for traceability

result.summary: Resolved IN-UI-06 blocker end-to-end: wired missing timeline route in runtime router, fixed timeline first-page render state handling, stabilized timeline fixture readiness in E2E setup, and validated F3 monitoring Playwright suite against real backend.
